name: Laguna Racer sound circuits
drawing: Laguna Racer Game Logic A084-90700-B622 (doc 1461b5f1ef33) and -A622 (doc 2e04e6b435f0) -- via MAME's netlist, compared with both
revision: Laguna Racer game logic board, sound section: as 280-ZZZAP's with C18 22uF and R30 100K.
coverage: Converted from MAME's netlist: the engine, skid and crash sounds and the final mix, up to the audio power amplifier. The CPU's sound latches (F4, F5) are ports; the rest of the game logic board is not in MAME.
